sentences.en: The principal causes are the growth of population, and the over-supply of and low rates of remuneration for manual labor in various Italian provinces.

sentences.en: Then there came a slump; probably the truth was rather that money was becoming less unnaturally abundant than that there was any over-supply of labour.
